decisionScope: Whether a leakage-safe predictive DMI baseline can be evaluated against the mechanistic reference on the current adult beef-pasture cow evidence. This is not full-engine validation.

estimand.population: Biologically mature beef cows managed on pasture, with maturity and production class explicitly defined by source metadata.
estimand.outcome: Individual total DMI in kg DM/animal/day for a defined animal-period.

candidateModels.reason: No eligible observed cohort exists for a same-case comparison.
Training is gated on an eligible target-matched dataset; none is currently available.

leakageAudit.reason: No source has accessible, reusable individual total-DMI labels for the target population, so group separation and train-only preprocessing cannot be executed or empirically verified.
leakageAudit.requiredSplitUnit: study_or_trial_id; keep all animal-period rows for each animal within its study in one partition
requiredControls: No random split of repeated animal-period rows.
Fit all preprocessing and feature selection on training groups only.
Keep trial/study groups disjoint across train, validation, and test where multiple groups exist.
Record feature provenance and exclude post-outcome or model-derived target leakage.

heldOutEvaluation.reason: No eligible rows or held-out groups are available; null means not measured, not zero error.

performance.reason: No model was fit or run.

limitations: This evidence-based no-go records that no target-matched individual DMI cohort is available. No independent expert review was obtained; this is not a scientific endorsement of model predictions.
No training, held-out evaluation, predictive metric, or product integration was performed.
The readiness matrix's dairy and feedlot component cohorts do not match the specified mature pasture beef-cow target.
No result from this artifact establishes empirical validity of the mechanistic reference or full simulation engine.
